card.name: Harsnapar
card.tagline: The bride's graceful solo wedding dance
card.profile: Harsnapar (Հարսնապար) is an Armenian wedding dance whose name combines hars (bride) and par (dance). It centers on the bride dancing a graceful solo, and may also feature the bridesmaids; the music is typically slow and elegant to match the bride's refined movements (Armenian dance, Wikipedia). It belongs to the family of Armenian ceremonial dances tied to specific life-cycle rituals such as weddings.
card.insight: As a dedicated bridal dance, harsnapar marks one of the central rites of passage in Armenian social life, with the dance form itself signalling the bride's transition and honoring her within the wedding celebration (Armenian dance).
card.image_significance: The Armenian bride's solo dance. A representative image shows upright carriage, sweeping arm lines and embroidered dress — national, Armenia.
